name: bloat
title: Isn't hypermedia bloated?
html:
Isn't hypermedia bloated?

Is hypermedia bloated? Measured

  • L0: every answer carries its forms, about 1.3 KB a loan.
  • L1: one shared form set per state, fetched once: 43% fewer bytes in all, loan answers 63% smaller.
  • L2: the schemas are shared too. Everything shared is content-addressed and cached.
Priya

Fifteen people, every book, and the forms in every answer. Isn't that a lot of bytes? And a lot of round trips?

Sam

At L0, yes: every loan carries its forms, over a kilobyte each.

Sam

At L1, a loan carries a link to its forms instead. Every loan in the same state links the same set, at an address that never changes, so the client fetches it once and keeps it.

Priya

How many sets, for the whole company?

Sam

Four. At L2 the schemas move out of the sets too, shared the same way: two more requests, here.

The same run, atRequestsBytes receivedOne loan's answerTime on the wire
L0, forms in every answer11089,1681,283 bytes350 ms
L1, forms linked, one set per state114: 110 + 4 sets, once each50,722 (−43%)473 bytes (−63%)221 ms
L2, schemas linked too116: + 2 schemas50,940473 bytes242 ms

The kept company script for Harbor Point, run with no model at each rung, measured from its own exchanges. The times are one machine's loopback: read them as proportions.

A loan at L0: its forms inside it 
{ "id": 3321, "title": "The Phantom Tollbooth",
  "standing": "renewable for the member", …,
  "_links": { "self": …, "hr:unavailable": … },
  "_forms": {
    "library:renew-for-member": {
      "title": "Renew for the member", "method": "POST",
      "_links": { "target": { "href": "/loans/3321/actions/renew-for-member" } },
      "schema": { "required": ["card"], "properties": { "card": … } },
      "hr:integrity": "sha256-RqWa…" },
    "library:return": { … }
  } }
The same loan at L2: a link to the set 
{ "id": 3321, "title": "The Phantom Tollbooth",
  "standing": "renewable for the member", …,
  "_links": {
    "self": { "href": "/loans/3321" },
    "hr:forms": {
      "href": "/affordance-sets/e425ee854a3ee9ea",
      "integrity": "sha256-5CXu…" } } }
The set every loan renewable for the member links, fetched once 
GET /affordance-sets/e425ee854a3ee9ea

{ "_forms": {
    "library:renew-for-member": {
      "title": "Renew for the member", "method": "POST",
      "_links": { "target": { "href": "/loans/{id}/actions/renew-for-member", "templated": true } },
      "hr:templatePointers": { "id": "/id" },
      "schema": { "$ref": "/schemas/19c8347c0a72993e", "hr:integrity": "sha256-Gcg0…" } },
    "library:return": { … } } }
  • Shared: the target is a template, filled from each loan's own id, so one set serves every loan in its state.
  • Kept for good: its address is its content's digest, so it never changes there; the client checks it against the integrity the loan's link carries.
  • Measured by artie/rungs/measure.mjs from L0, L1 and L2.trace.yaml; the numbers and these answers in full are in rungs.yaml.
